name: Thomas Land Restaurant
description: A charming restaurant in the Thomas Land zone of Fuji-Q Highland themed to Thomas the Tank Engine — serving Japanese set meals, children favourites and themed desserts in a colourful and family-friendly atmosphere beloved by young visitors.

items.name: Thomas Curry Set
items.description: Japanese curry rice in a Thomas-themed presentation with salad

items.name: Kids Omelette Rice
items.description: Japanese omurice in a Thomas train shape with ketchup sauce

items.name: Thomas Pancakes
items.description: Fluffy Japanese pancakes decorated as Thomas characters

name: Stadium Restaurant
description: The main quick-service dining venue at Fuji-Q Highland serving generous Japanese meals including ramen, udon, katsu curry and Japanese set meals — the most popular and centrally located food outlet at the park with seating for hundreds.

items.name: Tonkatsu Curry
items.description: Japanese breaded pork cutlet on rice with rich curry sauce

items.name: Shoyu Ramen
items.description: Classic soy sauce broth ramen with chashu pork and nori

items.name: Udon Set
items.description: Thick udon noodles in dashi broth with tempura and side

items.name: Yakisoba
items.description: Japanese fried soba noodles with pork and vegetables

name: MOS Burger
description: Japan beloved MOS Burger fast food chain — serving the iconic Japanese-style rice burgers, teriyaki burgers and signature MOS Burgers that have made it the most loved domestic burger brand in Japan. A quick and satisfying option between rides.

items.name: MOS Burger
items.description: Signature MOS Burger with tomato sauce and fresh vegetables

items.name: Rice Burger Kinpira
items.description: Japanese rice bun burger with kinpira burdock filling

items.name: Teriyaki Burger
items.description: Teriyaki chicken burger with lettuce and mayonnaise

items.name: Shake
items.description: Creamy thick shake in chocolate or strawberry

name: Garden Kitchen
description: A pleasant outdoor casual dining area at Fuji-Q Highland serving light meals, snacks and drinks with beautiful views of Mount Fuji — the most scenic dining location at the park and perfect for enjoying the mountain backdrop while resting between attractions.

items.name: Soft Cream
items.description: Japanese soft serve ice cream — plain, matcha or swirl

items.name: Crepe
items.description: Fresh Japanese crepe with choice of filling

items.name: Hot Dog
items.description: Classic grilled hot dog in a toasted bun
